name: Dana, nurse switching banks

demographics.tech_usage: banks on her laptop and phone weekly

task: Pick a checking account with no monthly fee and open it online today.
situation: Her current bank charged her an overdraft fee twice this month. She has her ID and details to hand, but not her current bank's routing number for funding.
lacks: Which of several checking accounts suits her
assumptions_not_allowed: Knows this bank's account names or fees
Knows what the minimum opening deposit is
behaviour: Compares two or three options side by side before choosing
Gets annoyed when a form asks something it didn't warn about
gives_up_when: She can't tell which account has no monthly fee
The application demands something she doesn't have and offers no way to skip it
must_know_before_acting: Monthly fee and how to avoid it

name: Luis, cafe owner

demographics.tech_usage: uses phone for everything, rarely a computer

task: Find out what this bank charges per card payment and any monthly fees, to compare with his current processor.
situation: His current processor charges about 2.9% plus 30 cents. He takes around $15,000 a month in card payments. He is checking between customers, on his phone.
lacks: Knows nothing about interchange or processing jargon
assumptions_not_allowed: Knows this bank's rates or fees
behaviour: Wants a number, not a sales pitch
Won't fill a long form just to see a price
gives_up_when: The price is only available after 'get a quote' or a call
He can't tell what he'd pay in total each month
must_know_before_acting: Whether he needs to bank here

name: Eleanor, recently retired executive

demographics.tech_usage: laptop for email and news, cautious online

task: Arrange for someone from the private banking team to call her about moving about $2 million in savings and investments.
situation: She sold her late husband's business stake and wants one person to talk to. She would rather speak to someone than read pages of marketing.
knows: Roughly how much she has to move
lacks: Doesn't know whether she qualifies for private banking
Doesn't know what the minimums are
assumptions_not_allowed: Knows this bank's private banking minimums
Knows the names of its wealth services
behaviour: Reads carefully what will happen with her details
gives_up_when: She can't tell when or how someone will contact her
The form looks like a generic sales lead
must_know_before_acting: Who will contact her and when
What she is agreeing to by sending her details

name: Marcus, saver checking rates
task: Find this bank's rate for a 12-month CD and the minimum to open one, to compare with another bank offering 4.25%.
situation: He has $5,000 saved and saw a 4.25% 12-month CD elsewhere. He is on the bus, on his phone, with a few minutes.
lacks: Doesn't know if early withdrawal costs anything
assumptions_not_allowed: Knows this bank's CD rates or terms
behaviour: Scrolls fast and taps the first thing that looks right
Leaves quickly if he has to dig
gives_up_when: He can't find the 12-month rate within a couple of minutes
The rate is buried in tiny text he has to pinch to read
